canonical_statement: Let $\alpha(n)$ be such that every set of $n$ points in the unit disk contains three points which determine a triangle of area at most $\alpha(n)$. Estimate $\alpha(n)$.

must_determine: State a closed-form or standard asymptotic benchmark g(n) and prove α(n)=Θ(g(n)) or a sharper asymptotic equivalent for the canonical distinct-triple quantity.
No auxiliary answer metavariable or sandwich involving the mismatched simplex quantity substitutes for this direct determination.
close_branch_A.statement: GROWTH DETERMINATION CLOSE: determine the asymptotic order of the canonical α(n) with an explicit standard benchmark independent of α, giving matching upper and lower bounds.

must_determine: A theorem exposing inconsistency of an old auxiliary formalization is evidence for replacing that helper, not an independence result about the canonical α.
close_branch_B.statement: INDEPENDENCE CLOSE: only a genuine independence theorem for the canonical geometric extremal problem in a fixed standard base theory is an alternative to growth determination.

definitions:
Formal-semantics guard: for this frozen source record the current Lean target signature is exactly `theorem erdos_507.equivalent:
    α ~[atTop] (answer(sorry) : ℕ → ℝ)`. Its binder types, predicate meanings, coercions, filters, and endpoint conventions control any machine-level reformulation; the prose statement may not be used to weaken them.
Quantifier-order guard: preserve every explicit and implicit universal/existential quantifier exactly as stated; no finite checking or selected parameter family may substitute for the stated scope.

Geometric guard: points are distinct whenever stated; Euclidean distance, collinearity, convexity, incidence, and exact-shape conditions are not replaced by approximate/numerical versions. Similarity/affine normalization is allowed only with an exact invariance argument.
Threshold guard: every “at most/at least/more than/less than” boundary is literal; strict and non-strict inequalities and integer rounding may not be interchanged.

The immutable geometric prose is the controlling mathematical target because the frozen simplex encoding excludes collinear triples and therefore does not represent the stated extremal quantity. For n≥3, α(n)=sup over all n-point subsets S of the closed Euclidean unit disk of min{area(x,y,z): x,y,z∈S distinct}, where Euclidean area is the ordinary nonnegative unsigned area and collinear triples have area 0.

The point space is the standard Euclidean plane ℝ². The finite minimum over distinct triples exists for each S; the outer supremum is finite. Small n<3 are outside the asymptotic estimation target and receive no semantic weight.

Any Lean formalization used for closure must encode triples of distinct points without requiring affine independence, so collinear triples are included with area 0. The prior Affine.Simplex-based helper is treated as a different auxiliary quantity unless an exact equality theorem is proved.
invariants_that_must_survive_every_refor: α(n) is the worst-case, over all n distinct points in the closed Euclidean unit disk, of the minimum ordinary nonnegative area over all three distinct points; collinear triples contribute 0.
Every asymptotic comparison is along all natural n→∞ and uses the same canonical α.
known_traps: QUANTIFIER SLIP: exchanging ∀ and ∃, moving an epsilon/constant after the limiting variable, or replacing “all sufficiently large” by “infinitely many”.
SAMPLED-TO-UNIVERSAL: checking many finite instances and promoting the observation to an unrestricted theorem without a valid finite-reduction theorem.
DOMAIN DRIFT: proving a translated/scaled/relaxed version without an exact map back to the original domain, endpoints, and discrete constraints.
STRENGTH CONFUSION: refuting a stronger folklore conjecture does not refute the canonical claim; proving a weaker statement does not prove it.

FORMAL/PROSE DRIFT: a Lean proof is acceptable only if the exact frozen signature is semantically the same target. `answer(sorry)` or independently filled answer metavariables are not permission to choose an easier proposition/function.
BOUND-AS-ANSWER TRAP: an improved record bound or candidate constant is not a determination unless matching lower/upper (or necessary/sufficient) proofs establish exactness.

MULTI-FORMAL-TARGET TRAP: the frozen Lean source records 3 open declarations. The primary target signature is not permission to ignore other canonical clauses/variants that are part of the problem statement.
COLLINEAR-TRIPLE HIDING: excluding collinear triples changes the extremal function and invalidates transfer of bounds without an equality theorem.
non_results: A theorem for only a selected finite set of parameter values when the statement is uniform or asymptotic.
A result only on a favorable subsequence, density-one subset, almost-everywhere set, or “generic” family when the canonical statement requires the full sequence/all objects.
A numerical fit, heuristic, Monte Carlo result, floating-point experiment, or finite computation without a proved finite-reduction/transfer theorem to the canonical claim.
A restricted-family result obtained by adding hypotheses not present in the statement, unless those hypotheses are proved without loss of generality for every canonical instance.
A conditional theorem whose decisive premise is an unproved conjecture of comparable strength.
A reduction to an equivalent-strength open problem, a tautological rephrasing, or a definition of the requested answer in terms of the original target predicate.
A continuous/real-valued/LP/SDP relaxation without a proved integrality or exact-transfer theorem when the canonical objects are discrete.
A stronger-looking statement in a different normalization/domain that does not formally imply the canonical statement.
Any isolated improved upper or lower bound that does not determine the requested value/order/classification.
A conjectured optimal constant/exponent/class based on computation without matching achievability and impossibility proofs.
Declaring the residual cases “open” instead of resolving them or proving genuine independence.
Known interval bounds, a sandwich with an unspecified intermediate function, or a result for the affine-independent-triples auxiliary quantity does not determine canonical α.
A benchmark defined using α itself or an answer metavariable is circular and not an estimate.
permitted_background: Only independently verified geometric theorems whose hypotheses and extremal quantity match the canonical distinct-triple α may be used as background.
Declarations in a frozen source file that depend on an incompatible affine-simplex helper or are closed only by `sorry` are not premises for the close.
